text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text:
We did it!
That's the end of the monster, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったぁ！
これで魔物を倒せたよね！？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: No... I can still feel a dark presence ahead of us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ……
まだこの先にも
魔物の気配を感じますわ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of us?
Ah! Look, a path just opened up over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この先って……
あっ、
なんだか奥に行けるようになったよ！？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text:
No beast that would harm my love can be allowed to roam free.
We must give chase at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのおかたを傷つける輩を野放しにはできませんわ。
すぐに向かいましょう！
